svg.title: Archived NQR branches versus temperature
svg.desc: All available input frequencies are plotted using their original branch labels. Lines stop at missing values and large temperature gaps. Missing values are not treated as merged lines.

g.text: 24 recorded temperatures · 18 complete quartets · original branch labels retained
Markers: input centres; lines: guides to the eye. Missing values are not interpreted as merged lines.
Segments break at empty cells or a temperature gap > 40 K. Scalar metrics use only complete quartets.
